title: Who audits the auditor? R3 development-round results
description: Per-trace results (no trace content) behind the preliminary note 'Who audits the auditor? A preliminary check of reward-hacking judges'. Known reward hacks were planted into copies of real coding-agent traces on Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks; a rule-based auditor and an LLM judge were scored on catching them. Development round: shows auditor behaviour, not error rates.
